name: OpenGVLab/InternVL3-8B model card - benchmark tables published as images
notes: This card publishes its benchmark results only as images hosted under datasets/Weiyun1025/InternVL-Performance (math.png, ocr.png, multi-images.png, comprehensive.png, grounding.png, multilingual.png, video.png, gui.png, vsi.png, plus an overall.png / overall-table.png release summary). The README carries no numeric benchmark text, so every row read from it is a figure read with a by-eye caveat. The summary table disagrees with the per-capability paper tables on at least MMMU (65.6 vs 62.7), so the per-capability tables are the ones to prefer.
